summary: Every stream payload (ready, event, resync and ping) checks the current original session/token without touching usage metadata, canonical workspace identity/ownership, tenant existence, role and SSO policy.

Pull-driven native ReadableStream has highWaterMark 0; pending queue limited to 128 events and 256 KiB, compacted event data to 7500 bytes. Overflow causes explicit resync. Independent checks every 5 seconds fail closed; storage timeout also 5 seconds. All listeners/subscriptions/queue/timers are cleared on abort/revocation/shutdown/cancel.

Relay reconnect emits local bus resync; browser invalidates all canonical workspace queries and discards stale transient agent activity. Compacted events also resync. State/evidence/tasks/checks changes invalidate evidence-lineage.

Stored OIDC connection changes rotate a non-secret provider generation; warm caches bind generation, current issuer/client and sealed secret identity. Flows pin generation. Callback rereads enabled connection/current admission policy under locks after network exchange; identity and session creation commit together.
Required-SSO role lookup now fails closed if no enabled own connection matches; RunQueueFullError maps to HTTP429.
interfaces: AuthService.assertWorkspaceAccess({kind:user|token,value}, {kind,id}, canonicalWorkspaceId, expectedTenantId, capability=workspace.read): Promise<void>. Throws existing authorization/not-found errors; reads inside a short transaction and releases it before stream enqueue.

SsoConnection.providerGeneration?: string and LoginFlow.providerGeneration?: string added only in storage/identity.ts. Existing connection rows need no migration; existing login flows without generation restart cleanly. No core type edits.
EventBus.resync(): void and subscribeResync(listener): unsubscribe added for instance-wide ephemeral-delivery gaps.

workspaceEventStream({bus,workspaceId,authorize,signals?,stopping?,recheckMs?}) returns a pull-driven ReadableStream<Uint8Array>. The HTTP event framing still uses ready/visua/ping; adds resync with canonical workspaceId. No durable replay guarantee.
Pg LISTEN connection application_name now visua-events:<bus.instanceId>, enabling exact test-connection termination and distinguishing instances.
OIDC callback lock order: sso-domains, ws:<tenant>, identity:<issuer>|<subject>; no network exchange while locked. Existing SSO writers already take sso-domains; membership changes take ws:<tenant>.

One already-started storage query may finish after a stream closes because the storage API has no cancellation primitive. The stream releases listeners/timers/queue immediately, schedules no additional checks and cannot deliver its eventual result.
Authorization is checked immediately before enqueue after its read transaction ends. Bytes already accepted by the HTTP/socket transport cannot be recalled on later revocation.

Provider generation covers stored organization connections. The operator-configured platform provider remains runtime configuration; changing that configuration across instances requires coordinated operator rollout.
The event relay remains ephemeral; explicit resync repairs reconnect/queue/partial-event gaps through canonical refetch, without replaying event IDs.
